payload.summary: Planned the repair of architecture freshness evidence after verifying that the RPC entry point decides staleness by file mtime against a 6-hour threshold while the content-based engine it is supposed to use sits unreached. The originating seven-item request was split: items 1-3 (this change) have no spec-baseline dependency and land now; items 4-7 become rescope-context-drift-enforcement, gated on archiving four complete-but-unarchived prerequisite changes.

decisions.title: Split the seven-item request into two changes
decisions.rationale: Items 4-7 modify requirements that exist only as ## ADDED deltas inside four unarchived changes, so a ## MODIFIED delta has no archived baseline and fails openspec validate --strict. Items 1-3 target the archived architecture-refresh spec and have zero file contention -- rpc_server.py and .gitattributes are referenced by none of the 64 active changes.

decisions.title: Provenance records an artifact tier rather than dropping untracked artifacts
decisions.rationale: Selected over the smaller alternative at Gate 1. Erasing the uncommitted artifacts from _OWNED_TOP_LEVEL would make 'deliberately uncommitted' indistinguishable from 'failed to generate', and would leave a stale local cache undetectable. A typed tier keeps the record auditable and gives the vocabulary for moving architecture.graph.json later without a second schema migration.

decisions.title: tier is required and enumerated, not optional-with-default
decisions.rationale: Artifact items are additionalProperties: false and freshness fails closed on schema-invalid provenance. A defaulted tier would let a pre-change record read as 'committed' for every entry, which is the exact silent misclassification the field exists to prevent. Forces schema_version 1 -> 2.

decisions.title: Legacy mtime probe stays reachable, but only when no repository resolves
decisions.rationale: The spec says the deprecated max_age_hours and graph_mtime fields MAY remain, test_rpc_server.py:314 pins legacy mode deliberately, and a source export with no .git is still supported by input_enumeration_strategy. The defect was never that the branch exists -- it is that get_server() never looked for a repository.

decisions.title: architecture.graph.json and architecture.diagnostics.json stay committed
decisions.rationale: The graph is read out of git history by checkpoint.py:339 and by the architecture-diff target feeding validate-feature's new-cycle gate, and it is required=True with roughly twenty readers. The consumer scan found no hard reader for treesitter_enrichment.json, python_analysis.json, or parallel_zones.json, so only those three move to local-cache.

next_steps: Start with wp-contracts: task 1.1 must fail before 1.5 lands.
wp-rpc and wp-merge-hygiene can dispatch immediately in parallel with wp-contracts -- their write scopes are disjoint and they carry no dependencies.

wp-artifacts must not start before wp-provenance completes: untracking a recorded artifact while check_freshness still treats every absence as ARTIFACT_MISSING turns the drift gate red in every clean clone.
